notes: Company summary: mid-market SaaS contact center platform used by ~350 enterprise customers. Primary product is a cloud-native agent desktop + routing + workforce mgmt.

Why Redwood: need low-latency streaming agent assist for live agents (typeahead suggestions, canned responses, knowledge retrieval), plus safe tool-calling into their internal CRM and ticketing flows.
Workload profile: avg 300 concurrent agents, baseline ~200 req/s for assist endpoint, peak events up to 3k concurrent agents (~2.5-3k req/s) during product incidents/promotions.
SLOs requested: 95th-pct end-to-end suggestion time <200ms; p50 ~60-80ms for first streaming token; tail under burst no worse than 400ms with graceful degradation.

POC scope: 2-week sandbox POC -> measure streaming latency, throughput, and behavior under synthetic spikes; validate function/tool-calling to their ticket API (Auth via mTLS), verify audit logs show ticket write calls.
Guardrails: must support token-level rate limiting, response filters (PII redaction), enforcement of agent-level command allowlist for tool calls.
Integration notes: UI uses SSE for token streaming; need continuous streaming without reconnects. KV-cache suggestions for repeated prompts to reduce token cost.

Security/compliance: customer requires SSO/SAML, SOC2 compliance evidence, KMS-managed keys, and logs retained 2 years for audits in NA region. Data residency required for EU customers served by EU region (future phase).

Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for Dedicated capacity for predictable latency but want Optimize suggestions to minimize per-token cost (batching, quantization). Estimated ARR range noted above.
Quotes / paraphrase: 'If the suggestions lag or drop during spikes, our CSAT tanks — we need predictable latency more than raw model quality.'
